sources.title: Tanzania eVisa guidelines: visible nationality schedules and online processing
sources.officialityEvidence: Actual complete HTML read using ordinary trusted HTTPS after a browser-reader timeout. HTML comments were removed before interpreting the current visible lists. The visible exemption paragraph expressly excludes Nigeria from Commonwealth visa-free treatment, but Nigeria appears in neither the visible named arrival-visa list nor the visible referral list. An older commented-out referral paragraph still names Nigeria and is not treated as operative current guidance.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Nationals from the listed countries below are eligible for both Online as well as on arrival Visa facility.

sources.title: Tanzania High Commission Abuja visa information for Nigerian applicants
sources.publisher: High Commission of the United Republic of Tanzania in Abuja
sources.officialityEvidence: Actual complete destination mission page opened and read, including Nigerian tourist fee rows, referred-visa passages and its statement that the entry officer determines stay. This mixed guidance establishes that the mission handles Nigerian visitor applications but does not directly reconcile current Nigerian arrival eligibility with the central visible lists. Its fee-table ninety-day wording is not promoted as a newly verified stay.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The duration to remain in the country is determined by the immigration officer at the port of entry.

unresolved.reason: The current Nigerian ordinary-passport baseline between pre-travel electronic issuance and visa on arrival is not established. The actual central page expressly excludes Nigeria from the Commonwealth exemption but names it in neither visible arrival nor referral schedule. A legacy paragraph naming Nigerian referral treatment is an HTML comment and cannot establish current force; removal from the visible referral list does not positively grant arrival eligibility. General online instructions and the mission's Nigerian tourist application rows do not establish the easiest nationality-wide route. No new rank-grade status, commencement or stay is promoted.
